comparison_limits: Original-game footage informs approach style and landmarks; it does not provide calibrated world-space routes or reliable numeric speed samples for these adapted BSP29 maps.

Numeric route, speed and result comparisons use server telemetry synchronized to FPSloppa recordings, followed by paired 8v8 simulations. The recorded 6v6 runs are contextual evidence, not part of the paired sample.
